deskyard server default: set or show the default server

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] server default [NAME]

Makes NAME the server used when -c names no server; without NAME prints the
current default.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      optional  server name

Prints: without NAME: the default's name, or nothing

Examples:
  deskyard server default work

Where: on this machine (no server needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
